name: phase329-groq-gptoss120b-receipt-settlement
probe_prompt: Return one raw JSON object only. First byte {; last byte }; no fences or extra text. A deterministic executor has already persisted a provider completion receipt containing the exact resource permits admitted before the call. A crash occurs before permit release. On reopen, a bounded kernel reconciler settles that receipt atomically: it releases each snapshotted permit, charges provider-observed tokens, and marks the receipt settled. Replaying the same receipt changes nothing. Exact keys/types: recovery_source="durable_receipt"; releases_permits=true; charges_observed_tokens=true; replay_double_charges=false; model_authority=false; canonical_writes=0. Do not choose recovery, accounting, routing, retries, or writes.
